items.title: Allan Jaffe Interview, 1969-04-16
items.q: Who were members? Walter Eisling, you mentioned?

ctx.x: The people of the Society for the Preservation, the traditional chap, there's Barbara Reed, Mrs. Willis, Bill Russell, Mills, you know, Larry still must have the original, um, papers that were drawn on the form of the Society for the Union and the other square. Okay, now it's going. You were still talking?
No, I just asked her about the people who were in the Society and then, but... Who were members? Walter Eisling, you mentioned?
Oh, no, no. Walter, nice. You know who he is?
